decision_rule: mixed iff calibrated P(mixed) >= t_mixed, else argmax of P(human), P(ai). t_mixed tuned on a held-out validation split carved from TRAIN.

calibration.js_note: After computing doc logits z[k] (classes order as in doc_model.classes), apply the per-class affine transform z[k] = w[k]*z[k] + b[k] BEFORE softmax, then softmax. The mixed threshold rule applies to the calibrated P(mixed).

sentence_model.note: word and char blocks are each L2-normalized separately, then concatenated [word | char]; coef aligns to that order. UNCHANGED from v13 (sentence head frozen).

s_prob.note: S_PROB = sigmoid(intercept + sum(coef[j] * (sfeats[j]-mean[j])/std[j])). sfeats are the 23 stylometric features in sfeats.js (parity-verified against sfeats.py). The specialist was trained on humanized-AI vs human only; it is a stacked feature, NOT a standalone detector (alone it calls plain AI human). The doc model learned how much to trust it alongside TF-IDF + A18.

doc_model.feature_order: [word TF-IDF (6000) | A18 aggregates (17) | S_PROB (1)]; S_PROB is the doc coef column at index 6017.

notes: Sentence P(AI) feeds the 17 aggregate features (11 sentence-score aggregates + 6 distribution features: sentence-length CV, mean sentence length, short-sentence fraction, sentence-score IQR, min, bottom-3 mean) plus S_PROB, the stacked stylometric-specialist probability. Doc logits -> CALIBRATION transform (see calibration object) -> softmax; the mixed threshold rule applies to calibrated probabilities. V36 is the first detector to pass the ship gate since V20 (16 straight holds): the stacked S-specialist replaced the appended S23 block of V35, which had let TF-IDF/A18 drown the stylometric signal. Humanized-AI training styles now span H1-H109 (fresh H105-H109 this round: late-night ramblings, grocery-aisle monologue, appliance rant, post-drive journal, hobby explainer) + real human texts passed through a humanizer rewrite (labeled human) as invariance training (DAMAGE recipe) + verbatim real human reflective essays, humanized classes oversampled x10, informal real human writing (HC3 ELI5) prioritized in the human pool, winner selected by a VAL + FPR-probe rule penalizing variants that raise the human false-positive rate; sentence head identical to v13. See REPORT-v36.md for measured held-out metrics and limitations. A score is a signal to review, never proof of authorship.
